Verified and closing **UI-014 / #30** after all three original criteria and source/results review.

- C1: composition is removed during both actually observed UIKit presentation and dismissal animations, followed by native detach and public immediate reopen without disposal notifications.
- C2: genuine Confirm/Cancel followed by caller removal invokes each semantic callback at most once; reopening and later caller disposal do not duplicate callbacks.
- C3: replacement uses a different real native parent; independent XCTest inside field tap/keyboard, outside-disabled tap and current outside-enabled tap obey the policy, with exactly one genuine outside dismissal.

- [ios-iphone/41593638135](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/41593638135) at [`ac5e1c4e`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/commit/ac5e1c4eea203ff521c01438151dd2da61db9ca7): **7/7 genuine iOS library methods**, 1 fresh original XML, zero failures/errors/skips, Gradle exit0/1558.79s and **23 authenticated public XCTest inputs**.
